senses.gloss: (perh. a contraction of עַתָּה כְמוֹ שֶׁהוּ) presently, now.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:14">Ab. I, 14</cite> <he>אם לא ע׳ אימתי</he> if not now (I provide for my soul), when? <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:3">Gitt. VII, 3</cite> <he>זה גטך … מע׳ אם מתי</he> this is thy letter of divorce … to take effect from now in the event of my dying from this disease.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 37a">Ab. Zar. 37ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כאילו אמר מע׳ דמי</he>, v. <cite ref="M01820"><he>מְנָת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:8">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>ע׳ העליונים וכ׳</he> now (in that case) the upper creatures would outnumber &c.; a. v. fr.
